description: data/biomes/world.json: the world a match plays on when its setup names none (WorldDefault; docs/world/world-default.md). Version field: schema. Policy: every key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore.

mode.description: arena: no planet key plays the hand-made arena (as before GW1b); planet: it plays the round planet.

fixed.description: The planet of a newcomer's first match and of the tests.

random.description: A quick match's planet, drawn from its own match seed.
